_note: Zombie drops (DESIGN.md "Zombies" variant table). items: what each pickup is and where it goes: ammo (a carried weapon's reserve, else the inventory's ammo store), inventory (a counter in the inventory), armour + amount (added to that bar on the spot; a full bar leaves it lying), firstAid (a kit; a full bag leaves it lying). color: the placeholder pickup's colour. tables: one per variant (and 'mutant'); every entry is rolled on its own, so one body can drop several things. min/max: how many (rounds, scrap); armour and kits always drop one. More items and variants can be added here without code changes. Ammo rates were cut hard after Aaron's M4 play-test (a headshot kill often paid back six rounds, so looting the world would never matter): on average a kill now returns about 0.1 rifle rounds, so ammo runs down and encounters stay worth looting.
